en.title: Find the Damaged Toy
en.description:
N children numbered 1..N sit in a circle. The first toy goes to child D, and the remaining toys are handed out one at a time in increasing order of number, wrapping around to 1. Find who receives the T-th (last) toy.

This site's input protocol and the explicitly stated supplementary ranges are compiled by CSWork and do not pose as the original OA rules.
en.input: A single line containing N T D. The original problem gives no numeric ranges; this site adds 1≤N,T≤10^9 and 1≤D≤N.
en.output: Output the 1-based number of the child who receives the last toy.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Renumber the children starting from 0. The first toy is at d−1; move forward another T−1 positions and take the result modulo N.
